QuestInfo.name: Mariwaka's Fox Tail Muffler 1
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9120016##k of #b#m801000000##k is just dying to obtain a special item. Speak with her to find out more!
QuestInfo.1: It turns out the new accessory #p9120016# desperately wants is a muffler made out of #t4000066#s. Why would she want to wear a muffler in such warm weather? In any case, you promised to gather 100 #t4000066#s from #m801000000#. Better get to work... \n\n#t4000066# #b#c4000066#/100#k
QuestInfo.2: You gave #p9120016# the 100 #t4000066#s, but it doesn't seem like all that much material. Can she really make a muffler out of these?

yes.0: Not bad. But will this be enough material to make my muffler? Hmm... Let me think.
